active_node.label: Active node
active_node.help_text: Hostname of the node that answered this request.

ha.label: HA
ha.help_text: Whether the installation runs more than one node.

install_uuid.label: Install UUID
install_uuid.help_text: Identifier unique to this installation, stable across restarts.

instance_groups.label: Instance groups
instance_groups.help_text: The instance groups in the mesh, each with its capacity and member nodes. Capacity shifts as jobs run, so a config that reads this diffs on every plan.

instances.label: Instances
instances.help_text: The nodes in the mesh, each with its type, capacity and last heartbeat. Heartbeats move on their own, so a config that reads this diffs on every plan.

version.label: Version
version.help_text: The AWX version this installation runs, which is not necessarily the version the provider was generated against.
